name_zh: 巴林珍珠/伊斯兰银行：伊斯兰金融治理与什叶派共识
name_en: Bahrain Pearls/Islamic Banking: Islamic Finance Governance & Shia Consensus
description_zh: 巴林哈马德·本·伊萨·阿勒哈利法 (1950-) 国王/2002 王国/珍珠/伊斯兰金融/巴林货币局/塔卡富尔/苏库克/什叶派多数/逊尼派统治/2011 珍珠圆环/海湾合作委员会/沙特/阿联酋/干预/政治改革/和解/金融科技/区块链/中东枢纽。核心模式：伊斯兰金融什叶派共识治理 — 伊斯兰银行/塔卡富尔/苏库克/什叶派/逊尼派/共识/改革/外交/枢纽/区块链/金融包容。体现 M220 伊斯兰金融治理 — 以"伊斯兰金融中心+什叶派共识+改革和解+区块链创新"四位一体，在宗派/改革/大国/金融四重张力中构建海湾伊斯兰金融模范。
description_en: Bahrain Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa (1950-) King/2002 Kingdom/pearls/Islamic finance/BMA/Takaful/Sukuk/Shia majority/Sunni rule/2011 Pearl Roundabout/GCC/Saudi/UAE/intervention/reform/reconciliation/fintech/blockchain/Middle East hub. Core model: Islamic Finance Shia Consensus Governance — Islamic banking/Takaful/Sukuk/Shia/Sunni/consensus/reform/diplomacy/hub/blockchain/financial inclusion. Exemplifies M220 Islamic Finance Governance — quaternity of 'Islamic finance hub + Shia consensus + reform reconciliation + blockchain innovation' building Gulf Islamic finance model amid quadruple tensions of sectarianism/reform/great powers/finance.
reason_zh: 巴林非单纯珍珠岛，而是"伊斯兰金融+什叶派共识+改革"三位一体海湾金融枢纽。伊斯兰金融(苏库克/塔卡富尔/塔卡富尔)提供经济引擎，什叶派多数/逊尼派统治需共识治理，2011 事件后改革/和解推动包容。M220 区隔于 M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M199 马来伊斯兰(文莱)、M219 议会君主(科威特)，核心在于"伊斯兰金融即经济引擎+什叶派共识即政治契约+改革即社会契约"的海湾伊斯兰金融治理范式。
reason_en: Bahrain not mere pearl island but 'Islamic finance + Shia consensus + reform' trinity Gulf financial hub. Islamic finance (Sukuk/Takaful/Takaful) provides economic engine, Shia majority/Sunni rule requires consensus governance, post-2011 reform/reconciliation drives inclusion. M220 distinct from M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M199 Malay Islamic (Brunei), M219 Parliamentary Monarchy (Kuwait), core: 'Islamic finance as economic engine + Shia consensus as political contract + reform as social contract' Gulf Islamic finance governance paradigm.
